title: Potato Gratin
description: A simple and delicious potato dish that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. This potato gratin is a great way to use up leftover potatoes and can be served as a side dish or a light lunch.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool slightly.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Pour some of the bechamel sauce over the potatoes, followed by a sprinkle of cheese.
Repeat this process until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.
